title: Meet Monique, the Chicken Sailing Around the World
main_content:
Guirec Soudee is sailing around the world.

The 24-year-old Frenchman has already been at sea for two years.

Soudee is the only person on his sailboat. But he is not making the trip alone. He brought along his pet chicken with him.

Soudee met Monique the hen on the Canary Islands shortly before he began his around-the-world voyage. At the time, the bird was only about four months old.

While planning for his trip, Soudee had considered bringing along an animal for companionship, but not necessarily a chicken. But as he told the BBC reporter, “the hen was an ideal choice.”

The sailing chicken has made international news.

The story has also become popular on social media.

Monique and her owner are currently in Greenland. You can find reports about Soudee’s trip on his Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube pages.
